ny.title: ZN Rock - Nine Years In (Official Music Video)
ny.desc:
Nine Years In - ZN Rock (Rock X, Vol. 2)

Nine years of anger at a man who slept just fine. If there is someone you are not speaking to, call them while they'll stay.

Listen: https://open.spotify.com/track/0rX6MRm2yGy1vpWWWl5sDO
Album, Rock X, Vol. 2: https://open.spotify.com/album/6dQfHarHJMVkTAkz394U1M
Other stores: https://music.lnk.to/ROIwVA

LYRICS
It was 2016, I can't tell you what he said
Something at a birthday that went sideways in my head
I remember being certain, I remember being loud
He told me he was sorry and I left before the crowd

Then a month became a year and I just let the quiet grow
Never made a single call and never let him know
Nobody has to do a thing to lose a twenty-year friend
You just stop, and then you can't, and then it's at an end

I was angry nine whole years
At a man who slept just fine
I kept a case I never sent
And I read it line by line
And the worst of it, the truth of it
Is the man I meant to burn
Never even felt the fire
And I'm the only one to learn

There were nights it kept me up, there were months I couldn't take
It got into everything I did and every choice I'd make
It made me mean, it made me small, it made me hard and old
And I called it having standards but I knew I'd just gone cold

And I don't know how to say this any plainer than it sounds
You wake up on a Tuesday and it's suddenly come clear
The only man who ever paid a dollar of that debt
Is the man who's standing here

I was angry nine whole years
At a man who slept just fine
I kept a case I never sent
And I read it line by line
And the worst of it, the truth of it
Is the man I meant to burn
Never even felt the fire
And I'm the only one to learn

I looked him up last summer
He's got two kids and a wife
He looks happy in the pictures
And I'm glad about his life

I'm not gonna go and call him
Nine years is a lot of ground
Some things you don't get back
You just quit dragging them around

So if there's someone you're not speaking to
And the reason's worn away
Call them while it's early
Call them while they'll stay

Because the door don't stay open
And it won't give you a sign
It just closes one afternoon
And you notice down the line

Call them (While they'll stay)
Call them (While they'll stay)
Some things you don't get back

ZN Rock - rock, post grunge.

th.title: ZN Rock - Tell Him I Made It (Official Music Video)
th.desc:
Tell Him I Made It - ZN Rock (Rock X, Vol. 1)

A man looks back at the kid in an old photograph and wishes someone could tell him it turns out fine.

Listen: https://open.spotify.com/track/7aPdg7MsI6Ne3enSoxT1DL
Album, Rock X, Vol. 1: https://open.spotify.com/album/4L0qZ3NZt00ZahR0WXBHKT
Other stores: https://music.lnk.to/2AvzyV

LYRICS
There's a kid in a photograph I hardly know
Beat-up jacket, twenty years ago
He had nothing in his pockets, nothing to his name
But he never once believed he'd stay the same

If he could see me standing here somehow
I'd tell him every hour of it was worth it now

Somebody tell him I made it
Somebody tell him I'm fine
Tell him the worst of it ends
Tell him he crosses that line
So tell him to hold on a while
Tell him it's worth every mile
Somebody tell him I made it

I've got the years he never thought he'd see
I've got every single thing he swore he'd be
But I never turned around to say his name
Or tell him that the fire he lit still burns the same

If he could hear me calling down the line
I'd tell him that he got it right the first time

Somebody tell him I made it
Somebody tell him I'm fine
Tell him the worst of it ends
Tell him he crosses that line
So tell him to hold on a while
Tell him it's worth every mile
Somebody tell him I made it

If I could send a message back through all these years
Past the doubt, past the fear
I'd say keep going, kid, you don't know it yet
But you're already him
You're already him

Somebody tell him I made it
Somebody tell him it's fine
He got through the worst of it
He already crossed that line
And tell him he held on a while
And it was worth every mile
Somebody tell him I made it

Tell him I made it
Tell him I made it (He's already him)
Tell him I made it
